scheme_name: Scholarships to Students with Disabilities Scheme
other_conditions: Student must have a disability of 40% or more as certified under the RPwD Act 2016
Family/guardian monthly income must not exceed ₹5,000
Student must have secured at least 40% marks in the previous annual examination
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹200 per month for classes 1‑8 and ₹300 per month for classes 9 and above for students with disabilities.
